essence: A wise practitioner, purified through tradition, should receive the mantra from a guru before proceeding.
The practitioner should offer oblations with the three sweets or with oleander flowers.
The practitioner should have the body anointed with sandalwood, aloeswood, and camphor.
The practitioner should be friendly to all beings, silent, and a worshipper of a maiden.
The deity is visualized as shining, four-armed, adorned with a pearl garland and a rosary.
